name: likeness
description: Markerless motion capture in the browser for any video source (webcam, video files, screen or WebRTC streams): face, lip-sync and hand tracking that drives 3D avatars, VRM models, VTuber apps and game engines

scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node .test-build/tests/solver.test.js && node .test-build/tests/hands.test.js && node .test-build/tests/bake.test.js && node .test-build/tests/landmarkModel.test.js && node .test-build/tests/driver.test.js && node .test-build/tests/frame.test.js && node .test-build/tests/tracking.test.js && node .test-build/tests/vrm-mapping.test.js && node .test-build/tests/stream.test.js && node tests/osc.test.mjs && node tests/bridge.test.mjs
scripts.build:lib: tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json && vite build -c vite.lib.config.ts && vite build -c vite.lib.config.ts --mode standalone
